## 12.1 Valuation Engine Selected

**Discounted cash flow (DCF) on equity owner FCF, with scenario weights.** I do NOT use:
- A single trailing P/E or EV/EBITDA multiple — this business cycles with the box office; 2025 was a record year and Q2 2026 beat; trailing multiples overstate the cyclically-adjusted earnings power.
- An OCF-minus-filed-capex model — the pack's filed capex of $8M is not the true reinvestment rate (SECTION 0).

**Owner FCF definition:** Adjusted EBITDA − cash interest − cash taxes − noncontrolling interest − total cash reinvestment (capex + capitalised software + JV investments).

This isolates the cash the business generates after ALL cash costs, before discretionary buybacks, attributable to IMAX's common shareholders.
